deprecation.message: The SmallEarthTech.SHFB package has been superceded by the EWSoftware.SHFB package and is no longer supported.

description: This package allows you to deploy the Sandcastle Help File Builder tools inside of a project to build help files without installing the tools manually such as on a build server.  Some limitations apply.  You will also need to install the reflection data set packages that you need for your projects.
title: Sandcastle Help File Builder - Test
